sources.note: Jernhusen's station plan of Stockholm C, January 2026 (PDF supplied by the owner): which shop is in which unit, and the units' outlines, traced from the plan's pictures. Placed by fitting each picture to OpenStreetMap: Centralhallen to its shop pins (median 3.3 m off), Nedre hallen at the same scale onto the escalators it shares with Centralhallen, Övre hallen to its entrances, escalator and shops (median 2.7 m), Cityterminalen to its shop pins (median 5.1 m). Not ODbL: Jernhusen hasn't licensed the plan; see data/stations/README.md.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract) with 7 hand connections for gaps in OSM; see connections[].note.
Level names checked against Jernhusen's station plan (Centralhallen, Nedre hallen, Övre hallen).
Shops, cafés and restaurants from Jernhusen's January 2026 plan, with their outlines: 67 places (25 new), 6 OSM places that the plan no longer lists or that were on the wrong floor removed.
